private_mode: operator attested; not exposed by Safari scripting dictionary
existing_browser_data: never read before pairing; only the attested dedicated one-tab test window afterward
callback_transfer: internal private pipe; no user copy/paste/Terminal entry
platform_permission: macOS Automation for Safari may require operator consent; no Accessibility/JavaScript enabling
local_only_smoke: owned tab data: page must support URL/source read before any Google navigation
window_closure: only the operator-attested dedicated one-tab test window
privacy: callback code only via internal stdout pipe; HTML becomes a fixed marker; no URL/cookie/body logging
